title: SDLC Task UID v1
description: The canonical repository-local identity of one materialized task envelope. It combines a WorkItemId with the task's eight-digit order key using a hyphen separator.
$comment: TaskUid has the form {WorkItemId}-{OrderKey}, for example WI-0001-80000000. The host may resolve the UID to a task envelope when a command performs semantic resolution; sdlc ref validate checks only this direct reference shape.
